# Promptok — AI TikTok Video Generator

> Promptok is an AI-powered platform that generates TikTok-ready videos from simple text prompts.

## What is Promptok?

Promptok lets content creators generate complete TikTok videos using AI. Users choose a theme (horror, fantasy, comedy, sci-fi, etc.), provide a prompt describing their video idea, and write or auto-generate narration text. The platform then uses AI to create a full video with generated scenes, AI voiceover, and captions — ready to post on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.

## How it works

1. Choose a theme (horror, fantasy, comedy, sci-fi, drama, mystery, romance, thriller, educational, motivational)
2. Write a prompt describing your video concept
3. Add narration text (or let AI generate it)
4. Select an AI voice
5. Generate — AI creates scenes, images, video clips, voiceover, and assembles the final vertical video

## Features

- AI script generation from prompts
- 10+ themed video styles
- Premium AI voices powered by ElevenLabs
- Full AI video generation (not just slideshows)
- Auto-synced captions
- 9:16 vertical format optimized for TikTok
- 1080x1920 resolution output
- Download as MP4

## Pricing

- Starter: $19/month — 5 videos/month, 3 voices, 720p
- Creator: $49/month — 20 videos/month, 10+ voices, 1080p, no watermark
- Pro: $99/month — 50 videos/month, all voices + cloning, API access

## Technology

Built with Next.js, powered by GPT-4o for script generation, FLUX for image generation, MiniMax Hailuo for video generation, and ElevenLabs for voice synthesis.
